cast.characterName: シムナ ラウトヤルヴィ
cast.originalCharacterName: シムナ ラウトヤルヴィ

segments.text: "...The name's Simuna."

A Scandinavian sniper. She is master at sniping the enemy without being noticed in the snowy fields. Is called the "Scandinavia's White Death" due to her abilities. Despite having lesser units and soldiers than the enemy forces, her team has managed to take down lots of enemies with only the few they have.
Based on Simo Häyhä, nicknamed "Simuna", who was a Finnish marksman.

cast.characterName: 酒井 忠
cast.originalCharacterName: 酒井 忠

segments.text: The current family head of the Sakai house and the leader of the Empire (Japan). She looks younger than she is: in fact, she participated in the Russo-Japanese War when she was younger.

cast.characterName: 真田 之乃
cast.originalCharacterName: 真田 之乃

segments.text: The current head of the Sanada family and a samurai who works for the Empire.
Based on Sanada Yukimura, who was a samurai warrior of the Sengoku period. Yukimura was called "A Hero who may appear once in a hundred years", "Crimson Demon of War" and "The Last Sengoku Hero."

cast.characterName: 立花 鑑
cast.originalCharacterName: 立花 鑑

segments.text: The only daughter of the Tachibana family and a samurai working for the Empire. She hates men because of her past: her family looked down on her because she wasn't born as a man.

segments.text: The only daughter of the Yagyuu family and also its successor.
Based on Yagyuu Jubei Mitsuyoshi, who was one of the most famous and romanticized of the samurai in Japan's feudal era.

cast.characterName: 本多 勝娘
cast.originalCharacterName: 本多 勝娘

segments.text: The daughter of the Honda family who is good at domestic chores.
Based on Honda Tadakatsu, who was a Japanese general (and later a daimyo) of the late Sengoku through early Edo period, who served Tokugawa Ieyasu.

segments.text: The current family head of the Date family and a great samurai. She is looking for her lost brother who is also a honorable samurai, Masamune, after he suddenly disappeared.
